name: sensei_pure_compute_zero
description: Pure function compute_mastery_score returns 0 when total is 0
input:
pure compute_mastery_score
  needs passed: Number, total: Number
  gives Number
  do
    if total == 0
      give 0
    give (passed / total) * 100

fn main
  result = compute_mastery_score(0, 0)
  say result
